purpose: Finished graphic targets after rejection of v011 for overly simple graphics

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create one extraordinary finished film-title style frame about the intoxicating money in the AI boom. Exact text "BILLIONS", as a single huge horizontal word. Black background, wide 16:9 cinema framing. This must be an exquisitely art-directed graphic, not a basic font with an outline or a logo mockup.
Lettering: original high-contrast engraved banknote/showcard capitals with dramatic split serifs, elegant swollen bowls, narrow waists, diamond-shaped counters, unexpected curling terminals, highly legible BILLIONS. The lettering dominates the frame, optically filling 85% width, with ornamental extensions reaching beyond the normal cap height. Surface: solid antique ivory faces with meticulously drawn gold contour engravings and black inset cuts, a few precise vermilion and cobalt offset edges. Surround the lettering with dense but controlled guilloche linework that grows FROM the letters and interweaves behind them; currency security-print craft, asymmetric exquisite swashes, not a rectangular decorative frame. A monumental central L/I rhythm, deeply considered kerning, thick and thin contrast. Tiny geometric security rosettes are integrated at only two points. Visible fine engraved line detail, but large clean letter faces keep readability.
Palette strictly black, ivory, warm gold, vermilion, cobalt. Predominantly hard-edged flat screenprinted vector-like shapes and linework; no blur, no photographic texture, no gradients, no fake 3D extrusion. The richness comes from authored geometry, layers and ornament. The composition is beautiful enough to be a finished theatrical title. No other text, watermarks, diagrams or labels. Keep all main letterforms inside frame with black margin; flourishes can approach its edges. A single finished artwork, not a contact sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept
Create an extraordinary finished typographic film-title frame about AI news arriving faster than anyone can absorb it. Exact word "NEXT", repeated three times as the entire graphic. Landscape 16:9, near-black background.
Three enormous NEXT identities are interwoven in an asymmetric diagonal composition: one main readable NEXT in the foreground, an oversized cropped outline NEXT behind and above it, and a smaller counter-rotated NEXT crossing the lower corner. Their letterforms are custom architectural constructions, with brutally compressed angular capitals, enormous diagonals, alternating solid slabs and precise arrays of parallel inlines, blade-like terminals, highly unusual negative spaces. Integrated negative-space cuts and selected sliced segments reveal the layer underneath. The three instances must feel like one authored collision of graphic systems, not evenly spaced repeated text.
The main text is electric chartreuse and bone-white with deep cobalt plane accents. The background outline text uses intricate fine cyan and cobalt contour paths, the smaller overlapping text vivid hot red. A few selected letter strokes expand into tight bundles of rails that turn corners through the composition, with negative black spaces deliberately preserving the reading NEXT. No generic glitch rectangles, no random tech UI or circuits, no particles. Highly sophisticated music-title design, aggressive and energetic but exceptionally balanced. Fine detail and extreme thick/thin contrast. Strict hard-edged flat colors, no gradients, no bevels, no blur, no lighting simulation. No caption, logo, signature or extra words. One finished cinematic graphic.

Use case: stylized-concept
Design one outstanding finished film-title image, exact text "KEEP UP". A visually seductive and slightly overwhelming film about accelerating AI progress and hype. Wide 16:9, pure black background. This must be MUCH richer and more authored than a plain italic logo with rainbow outlines.
Bespoke dramatic connected calligraphic lettering: KEEP across upper center; UP huge and off-center underneath, with flamboyant intertwined ornamental strokes. Complex sculptural letter architecture, tapered swashes that weave over and under the words, exaggerated teardrop counters, small sharp points, elaborate beautiful looping K and P. The words must remain unmistakably KEEP UP. The whole composition fills 85 percent of the frame with black breathing room and internal negative spaces.
Finish: expensive polished red enamel, old gold edging and cream specular highlight shapes, like flamboyant custom automotive signpainting. Design every highlight with graceful curved shapes that respond to thick and thin strokes. Deep wine-red shadows and an occasional rich blue reflected edge provide dimensional depth. Several swashes expose a cream/gold striped underside as they turn and pass behind the words; their overlaps must be clear and intentional. Two small star-like glints integrated into actual metal junctions, not scattered sparkle. Avoid generic uniform bevel, neon glow, rainbow inlines, plain typography, modern UI, posters with captions, and illustrative objects. Intricate but confident lettering craft, editorial asymmetry, rich local surface detail, cinematic finish. No text other than KEEP UP. One frame only, no panels.
